# Spray Foam Insurance Agent

> Spray Foam Insurance Agent (by Contractors Choice Agency) places commercial insurance for spray foam insulation contractors across the United States. Coverage lines: general liability, workers' compensation, inland marine & equipment (rigs, proportioners, heated hoses), commercial auto, contractors pollution liability (isocyanate & overspray exposure), commercial umbrella, tools & small equipment, and policy review & advocacy. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.

## Coverage lines (service pages)

- [General Liability Insurance](/services/general-liability): Overspray damage, completed-operations claims, and third-party bodily injury for spray foam contractors.
- [Workers' Compensation](/services/workers-compensation): Class codes, experience mods, and chemical/respiratory exposure coverage for applicators and crews.
- [Inland Marine & Equipment](/services/inland-marine): Proportioners, heated hoses, rigs, and trailers — replacement cost vs. ACV, theft, and breakdown coverage.
- [Commercial Auto](/services/commercial-auto): Trucks and vans hauling spray foam rigs, fleet and individual vehicle programs.
- [Contractors Pollution Liability](/services/contractors-pollution-liability): Isocyanate and chemical exposure, off-gassing claims, and clean-up costs — coverage standard GL excludes.
- [Commercial Umbrella](/services/commercial-umbrella): Excess limits above GL, auto, and employers' liability for larger contracts.
- [Tools & Small Equipment](/services/tools-equipment): Guns, hoses, meters, and jobsite hand tools — the items too small for an inland marine schedule.
- [Policy Review & Advocacy](/services/policy-review): Reading an existing policy for spray-foam-specific gaps, and advocating at claim time.

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Niche: commercial insurance for **spray foam insulation contractors** — applicators, rig owners, and insulation crews. This is not a general contractor program and not agricultural, dairy, or farm coverage.
- States: licensed and writing in all 50.
- Each service page carries FAQs with FAQPage JSON-LD schema.
